defects.title: Bathroom in Prohibited Zone (Brahmasthan (Center / Brahma Core))
defects.description: Bathroom is located in Brahmasthan (Center / Brahma Core). Vastu Shastra explicitly states that Toilet / Washroom must AVOID NORTH_EAST, CENTER, CENTER_BRAHMASTHAN.
defects.remedy: Relocate toilet fixtures away from North-East and central Brahmasthan to West or North-West. Never share common walls between a toilet and a Pooja room.
